subject: Good point!
author: TheGaroMan
body: Thanks, I just remembered how cheap the PC ones get after time, 5 Euros for paradise PC now so this one probably will lower too. I'm definately ordering for Xbox in a day or two!

subject: Xbox All the Way!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I would say definitely get it on Xbox, especially if it is a choice between the two. Online multiplayer looks like it is going to be INSANELY AWESOME! 👍 

I expect you will be able to pick up the PC version for next to nothing later on anyway.

If you do decide on the Xbox version, I look forward to seeing you in Seacrest County! ⛓️
